name: English
drop_subtitle: or click to choose files — several at once is fine
tip_add_files: Add files to the current selection
tip_format: Output container. “Original” keeps the source container.
tip_quality: Re-encoding quality (CRF/CQ, like HandBrake). “As source” skips re-encoding when possible.
tip_codec: “No changes” keeps the source codec. Hardware encoders (NVIDIA/Intel/AMD) are tested before starting; if they don't work, a software encoder is used.
tip_bitrate: Average video bitrate (e.g. 2000k) instead of quality. “No changes” keeps quality-based encoding (recommended). You can type your own value.
afmt_aac: AAC — compact and high quality, great for phones
afmt_ogg: OGG Vorbis — open format, lossy compression
qhint_source: The video is copied without re-encoding when the format allows it — instant and lossless
qhint_high: Visually lossless (like x264 CRF 18) — larger file
qhint_balanced: Nearly indistinguishable from the source, noticeably smaller file — recommended
qhint_small: Stronger compression for sharing and storage; fine detail gets slightly softer
card_logs_sub: Command and FFmpeg output of the last operation
tip_reset_output: Save next to the source file
chk_ask_dest_sub: When off, files go straight to the default folder (or next to the source)
chk_video_notify: Notify when a video is done
chk_video_notify_sub: A window with “Open file” and “Open folder” buttons
chk_audio_notify_sub: The same window once the soundtrack is saved
chk_sound_sub: A short system sound with the notification
set_accent_sub: The whole palette is derived from a single hue
chk_wave_sub: Smooth motion and a splash when switching sections
set_language_sub: Translations are JSON files in the locales folder
tip_language: The language is applied right away
tip_update_ffmpeg: Downloads the latest FFmpeg build (gyan.dev, release-essentials) next to the app. Requires internet.

tip_edit_selected: Open basic and advanced options for all ticked files
tip_remove_selected: Remove the ticked files from the list
card_video_all_sub: For every file without its own settings. “As source” plus “No changes” means an instant remux with no quality loss
tip_reset_item: Go back to the common settings
tip_item_settings: All options for this video: basic and advanced
tip_select_item: Tick to set up or process together with others
tip_mixed: The selected files currently have different values — they stay as they are unless you change this field
group_hint: Only the fields you change are applied; “mixed” means the files currently differ.
sec_quality_speed_sub: An exact value replaces the quality profile: lower means better and larger. Range: x264/x265 0–51, AV1/VP9 0–63, NVENC CQ 0–51.
Не понимаю время «{t}». Пример: 1:30 или: Can't read the time “{t}”. Example: 1:30 or 0:01:30.5
The trim end must be after the start.
Точное качество — целое число от 0 до 63: Exact quality must be a whole number from 0 to 63.
tip_item_extract_settings: All audio extraction options for this video: track, fragment, format
tip_extract_item: Extract audio from this video only
Не понимаю битрейт «{t}». Пример: 2500k: Can't read the bitrate “{t}”. Example: 2500k or 5M
The trim start is past the end of the file ({d}).
files_hint_audio2: Each file has its own format, bitrate and track; “Settings” adds a fragment and processing. Tick files to extract audio only from them.
⚠ There is no track {n} — using the first one.
В выбранных файлах нет звука: The selected files have no audio
tip_extract_bitrate: “Auto” gives high quality for the chosen format. FLAC and WAV need no bitrate — they are lossless.
tip_track: Which audio track to extract, e.g. another language or commentary. If the file has no such track, the first one is used.
sec_fragment_sub: Which part of the audio to keep. Time: 90, 1:30 or 0:01:30.5; leave empty for the very start or the end.
afmt_opus: Opus — best quality at low bitrates, for modern players and browsers
qhint_reencode: The chosen options need re-encoding — quality will be “Balanced”
tip_common_video: Format, quality, codec and audio for every file without its own settings
tip_common_audio: Format, bitrate and audio processing for every file without its own settings
files_hint3: Click a preview or “Settings” to open a file's options. Tick several to set them up together. For all files, use “Common settings” below.
card_extract_all_sub2: For every file without its own settings. A file gets its own track, format or fragment on its card or via “Settings”
